steps:
1. Create c:\Users\nm\IdeaProjects\Digital Clinical Decision Support System (DCDSS)\README.md with all sections from design Section 14:

    ## 1. Title & Overview
    Project: Digital Clinical Decision Support System (DCDSS) for Rural South African Hospitals. .NET 8 Web API backend. Roles: Doctor, Nurse, LaboratoryStaff, Administrator. Brief description of purpose (clinical decision support, lab management, medication safety, POPIA-compliant audit logging).

    ## 2. Prerequisites
    - .NET 8 SDK (8.0.427 or later): https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download
    - MySQL 8.0.x
    - dotnet-ef tool: dotnet tool install --global dotnet-ef --version 8.0.33

    ## 3. Restore & Build
    cd 'c:\Users\nm\IdeaProjects\Digital Clinical Decision Support System (DCDSS)'
    dotnet restore
    dotnet build

    ## 4. Configure MySQL
    Edit DCDSS/appsettings.json → ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection. Note AllowPublicKeyRetrieval=True for MySQL 8 caching_sha2_password auth. Create the database before running migrations.

    ## 5. EF Core Migrations
    Install dotnet-ef (see Prerequisites). Then:
    cd 'c:\Users\nm\IdeaProjects\Digital Clinical Decision Support System (DCDSS)\DCDSS'
    $env:ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT='Development'
    dotnet ef migrations add InitialCreate
    dotnet ef database update
    Note: MySqlServerVersion(8,0,34) is set explicitly so migrations scaffold without a live DB connection.

    ## 6. Initial Administrator
    A default admin is seeded on first startup from the AdminSeed configuration. In Development (appsettings.Development.json) the seeded password is Admin@12345. In Production (AdminSeed:Password = "") the seeder generates a cryptographically random password and logs it once at Warning level — capture it from the console and rotate immediately. Bootstrap flow: seed admin logs in → calls POST /api/auth/register to register staff accounts. NOTE: there is no forced-change-password flow in this version; rotation is the operator's responsibility.

    ## 7. Run the API
    cd 'c:\Users\nm\IdeaProjects\Digital Clinical Decision Support System (DCDSS)'
    dotnet run --project DCDSS
    Swagger UI: https://localhost:{port}/swagger (Development only)
    Health endpoint: /health

    ## 8. Authentication
    All endpoints except POST /api/auth/login require a JWT Bearer token. Steps:
    1. POST /api/auth/login with { "username": "admin", "password": "Admin@12345" }
    2. Copy the token from the response.
    3. In Swagger: click Authorize → enter: Bearer <token>
    Production note: override JwtSettings__SigningKey (env var, >=32 UTF-8 bytes, not the placeholder) — the app fails to start if the placeholder REPLACE_ME is present.

    ## 9. Endpoint Reference
    Table of all 17 endpoints (method, path, roles, request body, example curl). Include one sample request per module showing the correct flow: create medical record first (POST /api/medical-records) before ordering a lab test or prescribing. Example table rows:
    | Method | Path | Roles | Request Body | Notes |
    |--------|------|-------|--------------|-------|
    | POST | /api/auth/register | Administrator | RegisterDto | Returns UserDto |
    | POST | /api/auth/login | Anonymous | LoginDto | Returns JWT |
    | POST | /api/medical-records | Doctor, Nurse | CreateMedicalRecordDto | Required before lab order/medication |
    | GET | /api/patients | Doctor, Nurse, LaboratoryStaff | — | Paginated, ?page&pageSize&search |
    | POST | /api/patients | Doctor, Nurse | CreatePatientDto | Returns PatientDetailDto |
    | GET | /api/patients/{id} | Doctor, Nurse, LaboratoryStaff | — | Audited PHI read |
    | PUT | /api/patients/{id} | Doctor, Nurse | UpdatePatientDto | Full replace incl. allergies |
    | POST | /api/cds/evaluate | Doctor, Nurse | CdsEvaluationRequestDto | Supports optional PatientId |
    | POST | /api/laboratory/order | Doctor, Nurse | OrderLabTestDto | Requires existing RecordId |
    | PUT | /api/laboratory/results/{id} | LaboratoryStaff | UpdateLabResultDto | Auto-classifies status |
    | GET | /api/laboratory/patient/{patientId} | Doctor, Nurse, LaboratoryStaff | — | Audited PHI read |
    | POST | /api/medications | Doctor | CreateMedicationDto | Safety gate: 409 on Critical conflict |
    | PUT | /api/medications/{id}/discontinue | Doctor | — | Idempotent |
    | POST | /api/appointments | Doctor, Nurse, Administrator | CreateAppointmentDto | AppointmentDate must be future |
    | GET | /api/appointments/doctor/{doctorId} | Doctor, Nurse, Administrator | — | Ordered by date |
    | GET | /api/reports/monthly-stats | Administrator | — | ?month&year |
    | GET | /api/audit | Administrator | — | ?page&pageSize |

    ## 10. Project Structure
    Folder tree with one-line description per folder:
    DCDSS/ — project root (net8.0)
      Controllers/ — HTTP endpoints, routing, auth attributes
      Services/ — business logic implementations
      Services/Interfaces/ — service + repo abstractions (Core layer)
      Repositories/ — EF Core repository implementations
      Repositories/Interfaces/ — specific repo contracts
      Entities/ — EF Core entity POCOs
      Entities/Enums/ — enum types stored as strings
      DTOs/ — request/response shapes grouped by module
      DTOs/Common/ — PagedResult<T>, IAuditableResult
      Models/ — non-entity domain models
      Models/Cds/ — CDS rule and finding models, LabResultSelector
      Data/ — DbContext
      Data/Configurations/ — IEntityTypeConfiguration<T> per entity
      Middleware/ — GlobalExceptionMiddleware, AuditActionFilter/Attribute
      Security/ — CurrentUserService
      Configuration/ — typed IOptions<T> settings + JwtSettingsValidator
      Exceptions/ — NotFoundException, ConflictException, BusinessRuleException
      Migrations/ — EF Core generated migrations

    ## 11. Assumptions & Known Limitations
    List all documented deviations from Section 14 of the design:
    - PatientAllergy is a normalized child table (not a delimited string) for 3NF compliance.
    - AuditLog.UserId is nullable to capture unauthenticated events (e.g. failed login with unknown username).
    - LabResultStatus.Indeterminate is used when a result value is a threshold form (<5, >200) or qualitative — not misclassified as High/Low.
    - MedicalRecordStatus values are Active/Resolved/Archived (no value set in original schema — this is the assumed lifecycle).
    - No DELETE endpoints exist; lifecycle is managed via status fields. All FK relationships use OnDelete Restrict.
    - All DateTime stored and compared as UTC. Report month/year boundaries and appointment display times reflect UTC, not SAST (UTC+2). A SAST calendar day/month can split across UTC periods. Time-zone-aware storage is a backlog item.
    - Drug and allergen names must match the canonical seed names in ClinicalRuleStore for CDS matching to fire (e.g. 'Warfarin', 'Penicillin'). A controlled drug catalog is a future item.
    - No forced-password-change flow on first login. The bootstrap admin password must be rotated manually; see Section 6.
    - Units are not auto-converted between result value and reference range (e.g. mg/dL vs mmol/L). Classification proceeds numerically on the raw numbers; a warning is logged on mismatch.
